items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: then I got an offer from a guy named Roland Potter

ctx.x: Yeah - that's right. I--- our band--- some of the guys in our band, they were at the point now where a couple of them had to go away to school. And, we lost our piano player. He went to Michigan State. And, our band sort of got raggy and we didn't--- what I was doing then was that I didn't want to go back to school. I wanted to play. So, I was always looking for jobs with other guys; I played some of the towns around nearby -- I used to Bryan, Ohio and play for a woman called Della Casemere -- she would have me…
